unknowns: The author README describes LIBERO simulation, while the full paper separately verifies a small physical study; the README is not an exhaustive experiment account.

Physical task is approaching a colored chip cluster. Only mild feature suppression was safe; aggressive interventions destabilized the arm. Features were not cleanly task-specific, and coarse metrics do not establish fully interpretable or safely controllable general robot policies.

Full FLAIR2022 also verifies priorGeorgiaTech BarrettWAM learned policy-mixture execution with28participants, but it is older prior-host evidence, separate from current MobileALOHA. Its classical vision/PID components are not misdescribed as neural perception.
2025 Guided Strategy Discovery uses real demonstration collection but virtual table-tennis evaluation, so it is not added as current physical execution. LIBERO suites remain simulation.
